verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν τὴν Ἰεριχώ διήρχετο
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthōn tēn Ierichō diērcheto
verses.literal: Then Jesus entered - Jericho [and] was passing through

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ὀνόματι καλούμενος Ζακχαῖος καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ἀρχιτελώνης καὶ αὐτὸς πλούσιος
verses.transliteration: Kai idou anēr onomati kaloumenos Zakchaios kai autos ēn architelōnēs kai autos plousios
verses.literal: And [there was] a man named . . . Zacchaeus - - - a chief tax collector - [who was] very wealthy

verses.original: καὶ ἐζήτει ἰδεῖν τίς τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου ὅτι ἦν μικρὸς τῇ ἡλικίᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai ezētei idein tis ton Iēsoun estin kai ouk ēdynato apo tou ochlou hoti ēn mikros tē hēlikia
verses.literal: - He was trying to see who - Jesus was but vvv could not [see] over the crowd because he was small - in stature

verses.original: καὶ προδραμὼν εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν ἀνέβη ἐπὶ συκομορέαν ἵνα ἴδῃ αὐτόν ὅτι ἤμελλεν διέρχεσθαι ἐκείνης
verses.transliteration: kai prodramōn eis to emprosthen anebē epi sykomorean hina idē auton hoti ēmellen dierchesthai ekeinēs
verses.literal: So he ran on - ahead [and] climbed . . . a sycamore tree to see Him since [Jesus] was about to pass that [way]

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀναβλέψας εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ζακχαῖε σπεύσας κατάβηθι γὰρ με δεῖ μεῖναι ἐν σου τῷ οἴκῳ σήμερον
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs ēlthen epi ton topon ho Iēsous anablepsas eipen pros auton Zakchaie speusas katabēthi gar me dei meinai en sou tō oikō sēmeron
verses.literal: When . . . [Jesus] came to that place - [He] looked up [and] said . . . . . . Zacchaeus hurry down for I must stay at your - house today

verses.original: Καὶ σπεύσας κατέβη καὶ ὑπεδέξατο αὐτὸν χαίρων
verses.transliteration: Kai speusas katebē kai hypedexato auton chairōn
verses.literal: So [Zacchaeus] hurried down and welcomed Him joyfully

verses.original: καὶ πάντες ἰδόντες διεγόγγυζον λέγοντες ὅτι εἰσῆλθεν καταλῦσαι Παρὰ ἁμαρτωλῷ ἀνδρὶ
verses.transliteration: kai pantes idontes diegongyzon legontes hoti eisēlthen katalysai Para hamartōlō andri
verses.literal: And all [who] saw [this] began to grumble saying - He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man

verses.original: δὲ Ζακχαῖος Σταθεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν Κύριον Ἰδοὺ Κύριε τὰ ἡμίσιά τῶν μου ὑπαρχόντων δίδωμι τοῖς πτωχοῖς καὶ εἴ ἐσυκοφάντησα τι τινός ἀποδίδωμι τετραπλοῦν
verses.transliteration: de Zakchaios Statheis eipen pros ton Kyrion Idou Kyrie ta hēmisia tōn mou hyparchontōn didōmi tois ptōchois kai ei esykophantēsa ti tinos apodidōmi tetraploun
verses.literal: But Zacchaeus stood up [and] said to the Lord Look Lord - half of my possessions I give to the poor and if I have cheated vvv anyone I will repay [it] fourfold

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὅτι Σήμερον σωτηρία ἐγένετο τούτῳ τῷ οἴκῳ καθότι αὐτὸς καὶ ἐστιν υἱὸς Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Eipen pros auton hoti Sēmeron sōtēria egeneto toutō tō oikō kathoti autos kai estin huios Abraam
verses.literal: - - Jesus said to him - Today salvation has come to this - house because [this man] too is a son of Abraham

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἦλθεν ζητῆσαι καὶ σῶσαι τὸ ἀπολωλός
verses.transliteration: gar ho Huios tou anthrōpou ēlthen zētēsai kai sōsai to apolōlos
verses.literal: For the Son - of Man came to seek and to save the lost

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν Ἀκουόντων ταῦτα προσθεὶς εἶπεν παραβολὴν διὰ αὐτὸν τὸ εἶναι ἐγγὺς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ αὐτοὺς δοκεῖν ὅτι ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ μέλλει ἀναφαίνεσθαι παραχρῆμα
verses.transliteration: de autōn Akouontōn tauta prostheis eipen parabolēn dia auton to einai engys Ierousalēm kai autous dokein hoti hē basileia tou Theou mellei anaphainesthai parachrēma
verses.literal: While [the people] were listening to [this] [Jesus] proceeded to tell [them] a parable because He - was near Jerusalem and they thought - the kingdom - of God would appear imminently

verses.original: οὖν εἶπεν τις Ἄνθρωπός εὐγενὴς ἐπορεύθη εἰς μακρὰν χώραν λαβεῖν ἑαυτῷ βασιλείαν καὶ ὑποστρέψαι
verses.transliteration: oun eipen tis Anthrōpos eugenēs eporeuthē eis makran chōran labein heautō basileian kai hypostrepsai
verses.literal: So He said A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return

verses.original: δὲ καλέσας δέκα ἑαυτοῦ δούλους ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς δέκα μνᾶς Πραγματεύσασθε ἐν ᾧ ἔρχομαι καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: de kalesas deka heautou doulous edōken autois deka mnas Pragmateusasthe en hō erchomai kai eipen pros autous
verses.literal: Beforehand [he] called ten of his servants [and] gave them ten minas Conduct business [with this] until - I return - he said - -

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Οἱ πολῖται ἐμίσουν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπέστειλαν πρεσβείαν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ λέγοντες Οὐ θέλομεν τοῦτον βασιλεῦσαι ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de autou Hoi politai emisoun auton kai apesteilan presbeian opisō autou legontes Ou thelomen touton basileusai eph’ hēmas
verses.literal: But his - subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say vvv We do not want this [man] to rule over us

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτὸν τῷ ἐπανελθεῖν λαβόντα τὴν βασιλείαν καὶ εἶπεν φωνηθῆναι αὐτῷ τούτους τοὺς δούλους οἷς δεδώκει τὸ ἀργύριον ἵνα γνοῖ τί τίς διεπραγματεύσαντο
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en auton tō epanelthein labonta tēn basileian kai eipen phōnēthēnai autō toutous tous doulous hois dedōkei to argyrion hina gnoi ti tis diepragmateusanto
verses.literal: When . . . . . . he - returned from procuring [his] kingship - he summoned . . . . . . [the] - servants to whom he had given the money to find out what each one had earned

verses.original: δὲ ὁ πρῶτος Παρεγένετο λέγων Κύριε σου ἡ μνᾶ προσηργάσατο δέκα μνᾶς
verses.transliteration: de ho prōtos Paregeneto legōn Kyrie sou hē mna prosērgasato deka mnas
verses.literal: - The first [servant] came forward [and] said Master your - mina has produced ten {more} minas

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εὖγε ἀγαθὲ δοῦλε ὅτι ἐγένου πιστὸς ἐν ἐλαχίστῳ ἴσθι ἔχων ἐξουσίαν ἐπάνω δέκα πόλεων
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autō Euge agathe doule hoti egenou pistos en elachistō isthi echōn exousian epanō deka poleōn
verses.literal: - [His master] replied . . . Well done good servant Because you have been faithful in a very small matter you shall have authority over ten cities

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ δεύτερος ἦλθεν λέγων κύριε σου Ἡ μνᾶ ἐποίησεν πέντε μνᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai ho deuteros ēlthen legōn kyrie sou Hē mna epoiēsen pente mnas
verses.literal: - The second [servant] came [and] said Master your - mina has made five minas

verses.original: δὲ καὶ τούτῳ Εἶπεν Καὶ σὺ γίνου ἐπάνω πέντε πόλεων
verses.transliteration: de kai toutō Eipen Kai sy ginou epanō pente poleōn
verses.literal: And . . . to this one he said - You shall [have authority] over five cities

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ ἕτερος ἦλθεν λέγων Κύριε ἰδοὺ σου ἡ μνᾶ ἣν εἶχον ἀποκειμένην ἐν σουδαρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho heteros ēlthen legōn Kyrie idou sou hē mna hēn eichon apokeimenēn en soudariō
verses.literal: Then - another [servant] came [and] said Master here is your - mina which I have laid away . . . in a piece of cloth

verses.original: γάρ ἐφοβούμην σε ὅτι εἶ αὐστηρὸς ἄνθρωπος αἴρεις ὃ οὐκ ἔθηκας καὶ θερίζεις ὃ οὐκ ἔσπειρας
verses.transliteration: gar ephoboumēn se hoti ei austēros anthrōpos aireis ho ouk ethēkas kai therizeis ho ouk espeiras
verses.literal: For I was afraid of you because you are a harsh man You withdraw what vvv you did not deposit and reap what vvv you did not sow

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ πονηρὲ δοῦλε κρίνω σε Ἐκ σου τοῦ στόματός ᾔδεις ὅτι ἐγὼ εἰμι αὐστηρός ἄνθρωπος αἴρων ὃ οὐκ ἔθηκα καὶ θερίζων ὃ οὐκ ἔσπειρα
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ponēre doule krinō se Ek sou tou stomatos ēdeis hoti egō eimi austēros anthrōpos airōn ho ouk ethēka kai therizōn ho ouk espeira
verses.literal: [His master] replied . . . [You] wicked servant I will judge you by your - [own words] [So] you knew that I am a harsh man withdrawing what vvv I did not deposit and reaping what vvv I did not sow

verses.original: διὰ τί καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκάς μου τὸ ἀργύριον ἐπὶ τράπεζαν κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν ἂν ἔπραξα αὐτὸ σὺν τόκῳ
verses.transliteration: dia ti kai ouk edōkas mou to argyrion epi trapezan kagō elthōn an epraxa auto syn tokō
verses.literal: Why . . . then vvv did you not deposit my - money in [the] bank and upon my return . . . I could have collected it with interest

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς παρεστῶσιν Ἄρατε τὴν μνᾶν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ δότε τῷ ἔχοντι τὰς δέκα μνᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen tois parestōsin Arate tēn mnan ap’ autou kai dote tō echonti tas deka mnas
verses.literal: Then he told those standing by Take the mina from him and give [it] to the [one who] has - ten minas

verses.original: Κύριε Καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ ἔχει δέκα μνᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kyrie Kai eipan autō echei deka mnas
verses.literal: Master - they said - he [already] has ten -

verses.original: Λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι παντὶ τῷ ἔχοντι δοθήσεται δὲ τοῦ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπὸ
verses.transliteration: Legō hymin hoti panti tō echonti dothēsetai de tou mē echontos kai ho echei arthēsetai apo
verses.literal: [He replied,] ‘ I tell you that everyone who has will be given [more] but the [one who] {does} not have even what he has will be taken away from [him]

verses.original: πλὴν τούτους τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου τοὺς μὴ θελήσαντάς με βασιλεῦσαι ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἀγάγετε ὧδε καὶ κατασφάξατε αὐτοὺς ἔμπροσθέν μου
verses.transliteration: plēn toutous tous echthrous mou tous mē thelēsantas me basileusai ep’ autous agagete hōde kai katasphaxate autous emprosthen mou
verses.literal: And these - enemies of mine who vvv were unwilling [for] me to rule over them bring [them] here and slay them in front of me

verses.original: Καὶ εἰπὼν ταῦτα ἐπορεύετο ἔμπροσθεν ἀναβαίνων εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Kai eipōn tauta eporeueto emprosthen anabainōn eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: After [Jesus] had said this He went on ahead going up to Jerusalem

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤγγισεν εἰς Βηθφαγὴ καὶ Βηθανίαν πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν ἀπέστειλεν δύο τῶν μαθητῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto hōs ēngisen eis Bēthphagē kai Bēthanian pros to oros to kaloumenon Elaiōn apesteilen dyo tōn mathētōn
verses.literal: - vvv As He approached . . . Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount - of Olives He sent out two of [His] disciples

verses.original: λέγων Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν κώμην κατέναντι ἐν ᾗ εἰσπορευόμενοι εὑρήσετε πῶλον δεδεμένον ἐφ’ ὃν οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων πώποτε ἐκάθισεν καὶ λύσαντες αὐτὸν ἀγάγετε
verses.transliteration: legōn Hypagete eis tēn kōmēn katenanti en hē eisporeuomenoi heurēsete pōlon dedemenon eph’ hon oudeis anthrōpōn pōpote ekathisen kai lysantes auton agagete
verses.literal: saying Go into the village ahead [of you] vvv vvv [and] as you enter [it] you will find a colt tied [there] on which no one . . . {has} ever sat - Untie it [and] bring [it here]

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ἐρωτᾷ ὑμᾶς Διὰ τί λύετε οὕτως ἐρεῖτε Ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος ἔχει χρείαν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ean tis erōta hymas Dia ti lyete houtōs ereite Hoti HO Kyrios echei chreian autou
verses.literal: - If anyone asks - Why . . . are you untying [it] - tell [him] - The Lord vvv needs it

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι Ἀπελθόντες εὗρον καθὼς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de hoi apestalmenoi Apelthontes heuron kathōs eipen autois
verses.literal: So those who were sent went out [and] found [it] just as [Jesus] had told them

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν λυόντων τὸν πῶλον αὐτοῦ οἱ κύριοι εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτούς Τί λύετε τὸν πῶλον
verses.transliteration: de autōn lyontōn ton pōlon autou hoi kyrioi eipan pros autous Ti lyete ton pōlon
verses.literal: As they were untying the colt its - owners asked - - Why are you untying the colt

verses.original: ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος ἔχει χρείαν αὐτοῦ δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν
verses.transliteration: hoti Ho Kyrios echei chreian autou de Hoi eipan
verses.literal: - The Lord vvv needs it - - they answered

verses.original: Καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐπιρίψαντες αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐπὶ τὸν πῶλον ἐπεβίβασαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēgagon auton pros ton Iēsoun kai epiripsantes autōn ta himatia epi ton pōlon epebibasan ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: Then they led [the colt] to - Jesus - threw their - cloaks over - [it] [and] put [Jesus] on [it] . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Πορευομένου ὑπεστρώννυον ἑαυτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: de autou Poreuomenou hypestrōnnyon heautōn ta himatia en tē hodō
verses.literal: - As He rode along [ the people ] spread their - cloaks on the road

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐγγίζοντος ἤδη πρὸς τῇ καταβάσει τοῦ ὄρους τῶν Ἐλαιῶν τὸ ἅπαν πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν ἤρξαντο αἰνεῖν τὸν Θεὸν χαίροντες μεγάλῃ φωνῇ περὶ πασῶν δυνάμεων ὧν εἶδον
verses.transliteration: de autou engizontos ēdē pros tē katabasei tou orous tōn Elaiōn to hapan plēthos tōn mathētōn ērxanto ainein ton Theon chairontes megalē phōnē peri pasōn dynameōn hōn eidon
verses.literal: And as He approached . . . - the descent from the Mount - of Olives the whole multitude of disciples began to praise - God joyfully vvv in a loud voice for all [the] miracles - they had seen

verses.original: λέγοντες Εὐλογημένος ὁ Βασιλεὺς ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου εἰρήνη Ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις
verses.transliteration: legontes Eulogēmenos ho Basileus ho erchomenos en onomati Kyriou eirēnē En ouranō kai doxa en hypsistois
verses.literal: - Blessed is the King - who comes in [the] name of [the] Lord Peace in heaven and glory in [the] highest

verses.original: Καί τινες τῶν Φαρισαίων ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν Διδάσκαλε ἐπιτίμησον τοῖς σου μαθηταῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai tines tōn Pharisaiōn apo tou ochlou eipan pros auton Didaskale epitimēson tois sou mathētais
verses.literal: But some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Him Teacher rebuke - Your disciples

verses.original: Λέγω ὑμῖν Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ὅτι ἐὰν οὗτοι σιωπήσουσιν οἱ λίθοι κράξουσιν
verses.transliteration: Legō hymin Kai apokritheis eipen hoti ean houtoi siōpēsousin hoi lithoi kraxousin
verses.literal: I tell you - He answered . . . - if they remain silent the very stones will cry out

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἤγγισεν ἰδὼν τὴν πόλιν ἔκλαυσεν ἐπ’ αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs ēngisen idōn tēn polin eklausen ep’ autēn
verses.literal: - As [Jesus] approached [Jerusalem] [and] saw the city He wept over it

verses.original: λέγων ὅτι Εἰ ἔγνως ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ τὰ πρὸς σὺ εἰρήνην δὲ νῦν ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ σου ὀφθαλμῶν
verses.transliteration: legōn hoti Ei egnōs en tautē tē hēmera kai ta pros sy eirēnēn de nyn ekrybē apo sou ophthalmōn
verses.literal: [and] said - If only you had known on this - day - what [would bring] you peace But now it is hidden from your eyes

verses.original: ὅτι ἡμέραι ἥξουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ σου οἱ ἐχθροί παρεμβαλοῦσιν χάρακά σοι καὶ περικυκλώσουσίν σε καὶ συνέξουσίν σε πάντοθεν
verses.transliteration: hoti hēmerai hēxousin epi se kai sou hoi echthroi parembalousin charaka soi kai perikyklōsousin se kai synexousin se pantothen
verses.literal: For [the] days will come upon you [when] your - enemies vvv will barricade you and surround you and hem you in . . . on every side

verses.original: καὶ ἐδαφιοῦσίν σε καὶ σου τὰ τέκνα ἐν σοί καὶ οὐκ ἀφήσουσιν λίθον ἐπὶ λίθον ἐν σοί ἀνθ’ ὧν οὐκ ἔγνως τὸν καιρὸν σου τῆς ἐπισκοπῆς
verses.transliteration: kai edaphiousin se kai sou ta tekna en soi kai ouk aphēsousin lithon epi lithon en soi anth’ hōn ouk egnōs ton kairon sou tēs episkopēs
verses.literal: - They will level you to the ground you and [the] - children within your [walls] - vvv They will not leave one stone on [another] - - because . . . vvv you did not recognize the time of your - visitation [from God]

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἤρξατο ἐκβάλλειν τοὺς πωλοῦντας
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthōn eis to hieron ērxato ekballein tous pōlountas
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] entered . . . the temple [courts] [and] began to drive out those who were selling [there]

verses.original: λέγων αὐτοῖς Γέγραπται Καὶ μου ὁ οἶκός ἔσται οἶκος προσευχῆς δὲ ὑμεῖς ἐποιήσατε αὐτὸν Σπήλαιον λῃστῶν
verses.transliteration: legōn autois Gegraptai Kai mou ho oikos estai oikos proseuchēs de hymeis epoiēsate auton Spēlaion lēstōn
verses.literal: He declared to them It is written - My - house will be a house of prayer But you have made it a den of robbers

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καθ’ τὸ ἡμέραν δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι τοῦ λαοῦ ἐζήτουν ἀπολέσαι αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn didaskōn en tō hierō kath’ to hēmeran de hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis kai hoi prōtoi tou laou ezētoun apolesai auton
verses.literal: - [Jesus] was teaching at the temple every vvv day but the chief priests - - scribes and - leaders of the people were intent on killing Him

verses.original: καὶ οὐχ εὕρισκον τί τὸ ποιήσωσιν γὰρ ἅπας ὁ λαὸς ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ ἀκούων
verses.transliteration: kai ouch heuriskon ti to poiēsōsin gar hapas ho laos exekremato autou akouōn
verses.literal: Yet vvv they could not find a way - to do [so] because all the people hung vvv on His words
